title: Main session
summary: One agent owns the task and acceptance.
useWhen: The task is small or tightly coupled.
One decisive source or test can resolve it.
avoidWhen: Independent evidence needs isolation beyond a useful single context.
contract: State the deliverable and verify it.
example: Fix one documentation typo and check the surrounding instructions.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T[Task] --> M[Main agent]
  M --> V[Acceptance]
  V --> R[Result]
